communication-reach.flag: clause 13.16.36 is reached by the 2002 communication section (Annex A, the CD entry)
communication-reach.answer: SR19 applies only to an OCCURS 'in a data description entry included in a record description entry containing the EXTERNAL clause' (§2002:13.16.36.2 SR19), and EXTERNAL 'may be specified only in file description entries or in record description entries in the working-storage section' (§2002:13.16.20.2 SR1). Probe cdrec-ext.cob at 2002: a CD record with EXTERNAL is refused (COBOL2404), so no CD record meets SR19's condition.
